notes.title: Modified content of the game test version
notes.notes:
Regarding the game test version and the official version, the following adjustments have been made:

1.Fix game bugs
2.Adjust game values
3. Game play modifications
4. Add game operation tips

  
*The angel statue will appear only when the sin gauge is full, and the location will be different each time.
  
  Players must find the angel statue and pray within the time to obtain the treasure chest.

* There are random weapons, soul stones and other rewards in the treasure box

*If the prayer is not completed within the time, divine punishment will occur
